name: flowent-workspace
description: Just say what you need. Flowent gets it done.

scripts.check: pnpm check:app && pnpm check:flowent && pnpm check:rust
scripts.check:app: pnpm exec biome check . && pnpm typecheck
scripts.check:flowent: node scripts/flowent.mjs ruff check . && node scripts/flowent.mjs ruff format --check .
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path flowent-host/Cargo.toml --check && node scripts/cargo.mjs check && node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo check --manifest-path flowent-host/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path flowent-host/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.format: pnpm exec biome format --write . && node scripts/flowent.mjs ruff format . && cargo fmt --manifest-path app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path flowent-host/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint: pnpm exec biome lint . && node scripts/flowent.mjs ruff check . && node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path flowent-host/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm test:app && pnpm test:flowent && pnpm test:rust
scripts.test:rust: node scripts/cargo.mjs test && cargo test --manifest-path flowent-host/Cargo.toml
